entities.summary: James Alfred Fritsche was an American professional basketball player. Fritsche was selected in the first round of the 1953 NBA draft by the Minneapolis Lakers after a collegiate career at Hamline University. He played two seasons for three teams, the Lakers, Baltimore Bullets and Fort Wayne Pistons.
